result.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Distillation for Inductive Multi-View Embedding
result.comment: This paper was accepted at the GDDL (Geometric Distributional Deep Learning) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Gromov-Wasserstein multidimensional scaling (GW-MDS) learns low-dimensional representations from relational data but remains transductive, providing no explicit mapping for unseen samples. We introduce an inductive framework based on barycentric distillation. A GW-MDS teacher learns a latent support and an optimal transport plan from the training data, and barycentric projection converts the resulting coupling into sample-aligned targets. A neural student then learns an explicit out-of-sample mapping, avoiding additional relational-matrix construction and GW optimization at inference. We formulate the approach for single-view data and extend it to Mean-GWMDS and Multi-GWMDS teachers through consensus and selected-projection targets learned by a multi-view student with view-specific encoders. We also investigate a direct neural baseline trained solely with a GW objective. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data using Euclidean, geodesic, and cosine relations show that the distilled models preserve the teacher geometry on unseen samples and consistently outperform direct neural GW training in sample-indexed relational preservation. These results establish barycentric projection as an effective bridge between transductive GW embeddings and inductive neural mappings.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对 Gromov-Wasserstein 多维缩放只能直推、无法为未见样本给出映射的问题，提出基于重心投影蒸馏的归纳框架：由 GW-MDS 教师学习潜支撑与最优传输计划，将耦合转为样本对齐目标，再让神经学生网络学习显式样本外映射，并扩展到多视图版本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「传输计划→重心投影→学生映射」的思路可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态对齐与贡献分配提供线索，例如用最优传输衡量推理状态与视觉证据的匹配；但该文面向关系数据嵌入而非多模态推理，与 latent 状态生成和 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策的联系需进一步核查。
